question.text: Two bar magnets <math xmlns="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML"><mi mathvariant="normal">A</mi></math> and <math xmlns="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML"><mi mathvariant="normal">B</mi></math> are placed one over the other and are allowed to Vibrate in a vibration magnetometer. They make <math xmlns="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML"><mn>20</mn></math> oscillations per minute when the similar poles of <math xmlns="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML"><mi mathvariant="normal">A</mi></math> and <math xmlns="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML"><mi mathvariant="normal">B</mi></math> are on the same side, while they make <math xmlns="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML"><mn>15</mn></math> oscillations per minute when their opposite poles lie on the same side. If <math xmlns="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML"><msub><mi mathvariant="normal">M</mi><mi mathvariant="normal">A</mi></msub></math> and <math xmlns="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML"><msub><mi mathvariant="normal">M</mi><mi mathvariant="normal">B</mi></msub></math><sub> </sub>are the magnetic moments of <math xmlns="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML"><mi mathvariant="normal">A</mi></math> and <math xmlns="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML"><mi mathvariant="normal">B</mi></math> and if <math xmlns="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML"><msub><mi mathvariant="normal">M</mi><mi mathvariant="normal">A</mi></msub><mo>></mo><msub><mi mathvariant="normal">M</mi><mi mathvariant="normal">B</mi></msub></math>, the ratio of <math xmlns="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML"><msub><mi mathvariant="normal">M</mi><mi mathvariant="normal">A</mi></msub></math> and <math xmlns="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML"><msub><mi mathvariant="normal">M</mi><mi mathvariant="normal">B</mi></msub></math> is

solution.text:
Ratio of magnetic moments of two magnets of equal size when in same and different position is
 
M A M B = T d 2 + T s 2 T d 2 - T s 2 = v⁡ d 2 + v⁡ s 2 v⁡ d 2 - v⁡ s 2
 
   M A M B = 2 0 2 + 1 5 2 2 0 2 - 1 5 2
 
            =400+225400-225
 
MA:MB=25:7
